notes: Domain-based Message Authentication, Reporting and Conformance — the email-auth standard behind the p=reject records everyone eventually has to add. Said as a word, DEE-mark, never spelled out D-M-A-R-C; the whole deliverability literature (dmarcian, the vendor playbooks) reads it that way. Trending 2026-11-09 after Outlook.com started rejecting mail from domains with no DMARC record.
